title: [Bug Fix] #641100: Export Acc. Sched. to Excel - log report usage in OnPostReport to avoid modal page in write transaction
summary: Report 29 now logs financial report usage after processing instead of before, preventing a write transaction that blocked modal pages when exporting account schedules with multiple worksheets.
key_points: Moved LogReportUsage call from OnPreReport to OnPostReport to avoid open write transactions
Fixes PAGE.RunModal error when users updated Excel files with multiple sheets
OnPreReport still resolves CompanyDisplayName for report execution
Affected both W1 and NA layers which had identical defects
Added regression test to verify audit logs don't block modal pages
